name: pico-engine
author: picolabs.io
description: Pico Engine supports the pico-based reactive programming environment. See http://picolabs.io for more information.

scripts.out: lerna clean --yes && lerna exec -- npm i && rm -rf packages/*/package-lock.json && lerna exec --bail=false -- npm out
scripts.clean-setup: lerna clean --yes && rm -rf node_modules/ package-lock.json packages/*/package-lock.json && npm run setup -s
scripts.publish: npm run build && lerna publish from-package --yes
scripts.test:agent: cd packages/pico-engine-core && npx ava --serial ./test/picoSchema.ts && cd ../pico-engine && npx ava --serial ./test/ruleOutcomes.ts ./test/installFailureVisibility.ts ./test/mcpDevStdioE2e.ts --timeout=5m
scripts.test:schema: cd packages/krl-parser && npx ava test/docComment.ts && cd ../pico-engine-core && npx ava --serial ./test/picoSchema.ts && cd ../pico-engine && npx ava --serial ./test/uiTestingSchema.ts ./test/uiTestingHistorySaved.ts && cd ../.. && node tools/krl-schema/check-samples.js
scripts.link-framework: cd ../pico-framework && npm run build && rm -rf ../pico-engine/packages/krl-stdlib/node_modules/pico-framework ../pico-engine/packages/pico-engine-core/node_modules/pico-framework ../pico-engine/packages/pico-engine/node_modules/pico-framework && ln -sfn ../../../../pico-framework ../pico-engine/packages/krl-stdlib/node_modules/pico-framework && ln -sfn ../../../../pico-framework ../pico-engine/packages/pico-engine-core/node_modules/pico-framework && ln -sfn ../../../../pico-framework ../pico-engine/packages/pico-engine/node_modules/pico-framework && cd ../pico-engine && npm run build
